ag_plan.code:
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, ValidationError

class Item(BaseModel, extra='forbid'):
    item_id: str; tool: str; issue: str; change_type: str
    change_text: str = Field(max_length=600)
    safe_text: str = Field(max_length=300)
    evidence: list[str] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=5)
    confidence: float = Field(ge=0, le=1)

class Out(BaseModel, extra='forbid'):
    items: list[Item] = Field(max_length=12)

def plan(owner_token, digest, catalogue, llm, brain, min_conf=0.4):
    hints = find_issue_keys(digest)  # regex pre-step
    ctx = [brain.search(owner_token, q) for q in hints[:6]]  # owner's own token
    known = {k for d in digest for k in find_issue_keys([d])} | {r.issue for c in ctx for r in c}
    ptrs = {d.event_id for d in digest} | {r.uri for c in ctx for r in c}
    prompt = build_prompt(wrap_as_data(digest), wrap_as_data(ctx), catalogue)
    for attempt in range(2):  # 1 repair retry
        raw = llm(prompt, temperature=0, tools=[])  # tools stays empty, no token passed
        try:
            out = Out.model_validate_json(raw); break
        except ValidationError:
            prompt += '\nReturn valid JSON only.'
    else:
        return []
    good = []
    for i in out.items:  # grounding: the tricky part, drop anything the data does not support
        if i.tool in catalogue and i.change_type in catalogue[i.tool] and i.issue in known \
           and all(e in ptrs for e in i.evidence) and i.confidence >= min_conf:
            good.append(i)
    return good[:12]

pitfalls: Skipping normalisation: a copy with different case or punctuation slips through; normalise both sides
Storing the private shingle set or text: creates a second copy of private data; keep it in memory and drop it after the run
Treating an empty private source as no overlap: an outage then disables the guard; empty must mean block
